text: おまえも　いつまでも　ここらに　いないで　とっとと　さきに　すすめよ！

structure.jp: いつまでも　ここらに　いないで
structure.en: don't stay around here forever, and

structure.jp: とっとと　さきに　すすめよ！

patterns.name: 〜ないで
patterns.explanation: ないで after a verb means 'don't do that, and do this instead'. いないで = 'don't stay, and'.

patterns.name: 〜え (command)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb to an え sound makes a blunt order. すすめ = 'move on!'
